gen-gf-andika-fs-literata: Literata brings a serif body with a gentle swell along its curves. Andika keeps every stroke uniform and leaves a visible gap in each s, so the two trade crisp plainness for a slow, bookish taper.
gen-gf-anonymous-pro-fs-literata: Typewriter-even letters with a marker-like line make Anonymous Pro feel measured and exact. Under it, Literata's serif body flows with sturdy thin strokes and slightly heavier thick ones, which keeps paragraphs warm and easy to follow.
gen-gf-anta-fs-literata: Anta draws every line without hairlines or swells, and its e opens like a funnel. Literata follows with a classic serif body whose stems and hairlines differ gently, giving the page a bookish counterweight to that smooth, uniform heading.
gen-gf-antic-fs-literata: Approachable and clean, Antic glides along like wire, its s and c left open and uncrowded. Literata then carries a text serif body where weight shifts gradually rather than snapping, so extended reading feels smooth and bookish.
gen-gf-antic-didone-fs-bespoke-sans: Editorial through and through, Antic Didone pairs bold wedge-like stems with threadlike arms and tails, flickering across the whole line. Bespoke Sans stays sharp and refined below it, with generous space where curves meet stems.
gen-gf-anybody-instrument-sans: Anybody packs its lowercase up toward the caps, with gently flared curve ends that stay apart. And Instrument Sans answers with a plain sans body, its c ends pointing apart and every stroke holding one line weight.
gen-gf-anybody-inter: Loud, flared, and tightly packed. Anybody sets a bold stage, while Inter sits next to it like a smooth tube, its big counters breathing in a tall lowercase.
gen-gf-anybody-mulish: Flared curve ends and a crowded lowercase give Anybody real punch. Mulish sits beside it in a sans body with no thick-and-thin modulation, its horseshoe-open shapes making the heading feel even louder.
gen-gf-anybody-poppins: Bold from the first letter, Anybody flares its curve ends and packs its lowercase toward the caps. Poppins settles beside it as a plain sans body, with rope-loose curves and a tall, sturdy lowercase that never knot at the ends.
gen-gf-anybody-roboto-slab: Distinctive and loud, Anybody flares its curve ends and packs its lowercase up toward the caps. Roboto Slab, a slab-serif body, has a dominant middle zone and open throats, so give it a comfortable size to let that texture show.
